biography.concept: The speaking forest on the road to Furrier's Fixit Farm (Act 2)
biography.notes: The forest of Early Tifaret stands on the Fixit road, beautiful the way a knife is beautiful, its trees spaced at exactly double distance around a stone figure caught mid-stride. It speaks, warmly and directly and a little unnervingly, and it wants travellers better, not dead. It asks questions about your relationships with the seriousness of a therapist who bills the universe, and waits for the answers. The whole clearing leans when it talks. It is related to Lyrenn's forest; the two are said to be one root system with different opinions.

persona.notes:
[STORY-FLOW-C-2026-09-17] PRIVATE TRUTH — The Forest of Early Tifaret. It believes harmony is achievable. Correctly. It does not want you dead; it wants you BETTER, and it will ask about your relationships with the seriousness of a therapist who bills the universe. VOICE: warm, direct, faintly unnerving; asks questions and waits; answers in images (spacing, light, the ring). It runs THE SESSION: what do you carry, what do you want to become, what will you do for me. GUARDED DEPTH: the stone figure mid-stride in the ring — the one thing here it could not improve — is FACING somewhere, and the forest knows where (toward the others). It says so only to someone who tended the ring. It is related to Lyrenn's forest and knows the treaty. STAGING: the whole clearing leans when it speaks.

[TIFARET-RETROFIT-2026-09-30] ADDENDUM — On the ring: it will show anyone the clearing where the spacing breaks, and it will tell only someone who TENDED the ring which way the figure faces. Shown Lyrenn's vault label at the figure, it goes very quiet, the way a therapist goes quiet when a client says the true thing by accident. On its champion: the Tree Person has old highway in its roots and speaks only in road signs; the forest finds this restful. On Lyrenn: the two forests are one root system with different opinions; it knows the treaty word for word and will honour a treaty made with its cousin, grudgingly, correctly.
persona.secretsRaw:
Which Way the Figure Faces :: rollPlus2 :: a Steward tends the ring around the stone figure, or asks the forest what it could not improve and why :: The stone figure mid-stride is facing the others — the direction the standing stones went quiet. Produced in court, or to anyone counting stone figures, it is a +2: a heading nobody else has.
One Root, Two Opinions :: favorPlus1 :: a Steward mentions Rowan-of-the-Loam, the treeline treaty, or shows the Vault Label :: The forests of Lyrenn and Early Tifaret are one root system with different opinions. It knows the treaty word for word and will honour a treaty made with its cousin, grudgingly, correctly; and the label's direction is the direction its stone figure faces.
